newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris airports, FedEx sign Euro-hub pact.
newsitem.headline: Paris airports, FedEx sign Euro-hub pact.

text.p: The Paris airports authority (ADP) and Federal Express Corp have formally signed an agreement covering the expansion of Fedex's main European hub at Charles de Gaulle airport, the French transport ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.
In April this year, FedEx chairman Frederick Smith announced plans for the hub's expansion after talks with the French authorities.
FedEx obtained new air traffic rights from the French transport authorities for a proposed Memphis-Paris-Dubai-Subic Bay round-the world service.
It also said that the expansion would involve an investment of some two billion French francs and the creation of around 3,000 jobs over 10 years.

The ministry's latest statement added that the first phase of the planned expansion will see an investment of more than one billion francs and over 1,000 new jobs, but did not detail the length of the first phase.
